verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents 3,000+ APIs/10,000+ tools with per-app dedicated MCP servers (e.g., ClickUp, OpenAI tool lists) and an app marketplace, showing tools are discoverable by app/capability, but there is no evidence of a searchable/browsable registry UI or catalog search API specifically for exploring tools by capability before wiring in — most evidence focuses on connecting and auto-loading tools rather than pre-integration discovery. missing for 10: a dedicated searchable catalog/registry UI or API for browsing tools by capability, independent hands-on confirmation of search/browse functionality, and documentation of filtering/searching mechanics.
